release_notes: The mobile-usability release from tester Addendum VI, frontend-only and verified in a real browser at 390 / 768 / 1280 px. Campaign names: the desktop table cell now renders the campaign name the way the mobile card always has — the theme's primary colour at semibold — so the affordance that was already there (the name opens the editor) reads as a link on both surfaces; verified on the light default theme with the orange-red primary, the exact combination the addendum left unchecked. Campaign editor rotation rows: below 640px the landing/offer rows are a three-column CSS grid with explicit placements (toggle | name/badges/weight | action rail) instead of a wrapped flex line whose pieces landed wherever content width pushed them, and the name wraps instead of truncating, so a long offer name reads in full at phone width; from 640px up the single-row layout is untouched — the action rail dissolves back into the flex row. Checked: both row types, a four-line wrapped name, zero horizontal overflow.
